en: Revenue rose 70% to $1.31B, above the top of guidance and the ~$1.27B consensus, and non-GAAP EPS of $2.29 beat about $2.07. CEO Greg Smith said demand spanned the AI value chain: Memory and Integrated Systems Test set records, Semiconductor Test brought in $1.07B, and Robotics had its best Q3 at $96M and turned a profit. The Q4 guide of $1.25–1.35B and $1.95–2.25 of EPS topped consensus, but its midpoint is flat with Q3. The call is on Oct 28 at 8:30am ET.

Shares rose 4.8% to $323.68 in the regular session before the report, then fell about 5.5% after hours to $306 despite the beat. Investors weighed a flat Q4 midpoint, inventory days rising to 98 from 69, and whether AI test demand can keep compounding after revenue doubled in a year. At $306 the stock would sit about 37% below its $488 high.
zh: 营收增长 70% 至 13.1 亿美元，高于指引上限及约 12.7 亿美元的市场预期；非 GAAP 每股收益 2.29 美元，高于约 2.07 美元预期。CEO 格雷格·史密斯表示需求覆盖整个 AI 价值链：内存测试与集成系统测试均创纪录，半导体测试营收 10.7 亿美元，机器人业务以 9,600 万美元创第三季最佳并实现盈利。第四季指引营收 12.5–13.5 亿美元、每股收益 1.95–2.25 美元，高于预期，但中值与第三季持平。电话会议定于美东时间 10 月 28 日上午 8:30。
财报前常规交易时段股价上涨 4.8% 至 323.68 美元，财报后尽管业绩超预期，盘后仍下跌约 5.5% 至 306 美元。投资者担心第四季指引中值持平、库存天数由 69 天升至 98 天，以及营收一年内翻倍后 AI 测试需求能否持续增长。若以 306 美元计，股价较 488 美元高点低约 37%。

bio.en: Joined Teradyne in 2006 in semiconductor test marketing, ran the semiconductor test division from 2016 and the robotics group from 2020. President from 2022 and CEO since February 2023.
bio.zh: 2006 年加入泰瑞达，从事半导体测试市场工作，2016 年起执掌半导体测试部门，2020 年起负责机器人业务。2022 年任总裁，2023 年 2 月起任 CEO。

bio.en: CFO since November 2025, replacing Sanjay Mehta. Previously CFO of defense-technology group L3Harris, with earlier senior finance roles at Johnson & Johnson, BHP Billiton, Raytheon and Honeywell.
bio.zh: 2025 年 11 月接替桑杰·梅塔出任 CFO。此前任国防科技集团 L3Harris 的 CFO，更早在强生、必和必拓、雷神和霍尼韦尔担任财务要职。
